newsitem.title: CONGO: Zaire army chief killed - diplomats.
newsitem.headline: Zaire army chief killed - diplomats.

text.p: Zaire's army chief was killed by units of President Mobutu Sese Seko's elite guard late on Friday night, diplomatic sources in Kinshasa said early on Saturday.

The sources, reached by telephone from neighbouring Congo, said General Mahale Lieko Bokungu was killed at Camp Tshatshi. The camp is a military barracks and was also a residence of the ailing president who left the Zairean capital on Friday for his northern jungle palace at Gbadolite.
"Mahele was killed at the camp by the presidential guard," one senior diplomat said.
Mobutu, one of a vanishing breed of African strongmen, has stepped aside after over three decades of mostly absolute power and left his capital to an unknown fate.

With Laurent Kabila's rebels reported within striking distance of the city, a rebel spokesman urged residents to stay calm and at home and said Kabila would address the nation from his Lubumbashi headquarters on Saturday.
